skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic agricultural technology principles in post-harvest processing, including animal husbandry, crop care, and food processing and preservation.
Understand and apply biotechnological principles in animal husbandry and crop care.
Understand and apply food processing techniques for agricultural products.
Understand and apply food preservation techniques for agricultural products.
Analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of agricultural technologies and make informed decisions.
Conduct research, analyze, and synthesize information to select appropriate agricultural technologies.
Effectively communicate research findings and technological applications in agricultural settings.
Demonstrate the ability to self-learn and complete assigned tasks.
